display_name: WiSig 完整 R17 与实增益源域联合微调
description: 前两项冻结 R17 后附加恢复头均未通过筛查；固定 R02/R07 并联合微调 R17 三个 prior 与双方向实增益头，通过同契约原 R17 IQ 教师约束偏移，筛查未用过的源 RX4。
authorization: 当前聊天 01a2204f-647a-7903-ba29-81cfe8f8749b 的融合研发目标及 N607 有显存即启动要求。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32 TF32off; independent CPU scorer

data.representation: 256 complex points, 8 x 32 groups; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head for evaluation only
data.physical_ids_ref: all 360 source V IDs where RX=4; disjoint from first RX1 and second RX3 screens
data.label_map_ref: Original six classes; no L/U TX label used in training, source V label only after independent freeze
data.train_ratio: 7/63/30; use 52604 U after existing calibration exclusion
data.validation_ref: Reuse existing registered source cache and validated source roles
data.leo_config_ref: Registered source Full clean and practical_low_urban

permissions.claim_scope: Source U_s IQ and allowed generic simulated paired clean/received. Frozen same-contract R17 IQ teacher and WiSig realgain source model. No F weights/outputs, TX labels, V or target in fit. Independent CPU source V truth only after both view predictions freeze.

checkpoint.initialization: Exact same-contract source-selected full R17 unroll_unshared E20/4940; R02/R07 frozen; R17 prior weights trainable. New two-direction real gain zero initialized.

sources.role: frozen R02/R07, student R17 prior initialization and detached IQ teacher
frozen independently source-trained WiSig realgain direction and first fusion comparison
second F-free source-trained fusion as frozen comparison only

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original F0 source roles, existing validation_full IDs, strict source-only frozen checkpoint proofs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: All inherited models are WiSig same-contract source-only and TX/F-free. R17 source selection occurred before target evaluation; previous RX1/RX3 screens exposed for development.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 1500 updates. RX4 low-urban net >=2 per half against direct, original R17, realgain and both previous fusions; clean net >=-2 each. Report 2000 paired bootstrap interval. RX4 disjoint from RX1 and RX3.

execution.gpu_policy: One worker on first GPU with >=8192 MiB free in order 7,2,3,6,1,4,0,5; LoRa GPU5 protected.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on role/provenance mismatch, output collision, absent dual-head or R17 prior gradients, gradients on frozen R02/R07, nonfinite values, incomplete prediction or independent score failure. Preserve partial artifacts and other owners.

rows.method: R02/R07 frozen; initialize full R17 priors from original, jointly train priors and two-direction realgain with original R17 IQ teacher
rows.seed_notes: No support; evaluation seed fixes screen halves; RX4 existing physical IDs fixed independent of labels.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, cosine to 1e-6, prior LR 3e-5 and gain LR 3e-4
rows.budget_ref: 1500 steps x batch16 U_s = 24000 exposures; inherited costs separate

notes: Prior source screens RX1 and RX3 rejected frozen-prior corrections. RX4 is fixed before accessing its labels and does not overlap those receiver physical records.
Student R17 prior and gain train jointly, R02/R07 and original R17 waveform teacher remain frozen. No classifier or TX label is read during fit.
The 360-record source V screen has historical exposure from prior project work. All target data remain unopened by this run.
Use original uncompressed R17; model size is measured and not a constraint. DURA v1 remains a later formal comparator.
